title: Slow English Podcast #300: Al Ain - BAE

sentences.text: Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slowly.
Today, we travel to the Middle East.
We go to the United Arab Emirates.
Our city today is Al Ain.
Al Ain is full of history and tradition.
Part two, the United Arab Emirates.
The United Arab Emirates is a country in the Middle East.
But today, we visit Al Ain.
Al Ain is quiet and traditional.
Part three, where is Al Ain?
Al Ain is in the east of the UAE.
It is near the border with Oman.
The city is not on the sea.
It is in the desert area.
Because of this, people call it the garden city.
The city feels fresh and open.
Al Ain has a hot climate.
In summer, it is very hot.
In winter, the weather is warm.
People live with the sun and heat.
Life moves slowly because of the weather.
Part five, a city with long history.
Al Ain is one of the oldest cities in the UAE.
People lived here thousands of years ago.
The city was important for travel and trade.
Al Ain is a city of the past and present.
Al Ain is famous for its oases.
And oasis is a green place in the desert.
The Al Ain Oasis is very famous.
It is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Old water systems bring water to plants.
People learn about old life here.
The oasis shows balance between nature and people.
Near Al Ain, there are mountains.
One mountain is called Jabalha feet.
They look at the city from above.
The land looks calm and strong.
Nature is part of daily life in Al Ain.
Part nine, daily life in Al Ain.
Daily life in Al Ain is peaceful.
In the evening, people go outside.
Food in Al Ain is traditional.
People eat rice, meat and bread.
People in Al Ain are friendly.
Al Ain is a city of desert, water, history and calm life.
Al Ain shows another side of the UAE.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English podcast.
See you in the next episode.
